observations.text: Fatigue has been logged once so far, alongside single episodes of headache (mild) and heartburn, so no recurring pattern is established yet.

The Diabetes Panel from 2026-04-12 showed HbA1c of 8.4% and fasting plasma glucose of 171 mg/dL, both flagged high against reference ranges of 4.0-5.6% and 70-100 mg/dL. Estimated average glucose was 194 mg/dL.
Logged blood glucose is 161 mg/dL and has been stable. Blood pressure (134/84) and weight (82.6) are also stable.
